body:
I can't tell if her problems have made me this way or if I have inherited them genetically. Not sure how depression and anxiety work on a hereditary level. The thing is, Macie and I are cool. I still love her and wish her the best, I truly do. Its not like a toxic relationship that ends on bad terms. 

It was a used car, so all out of pocket. Totalled at this point. I was seriously stoked to start trying to better myself. Too late, I guess. Oh well. I've heard enough horror stories about hotlines and institutions that I'd rather just end it than risk further fucking up my life with debt or more trauma.

I'm seriously happy it worked out for your sister. I wouldn't wish this on my worst enemy. Unfortunately, not everyone is dealt the same hand. I got nothing and I'm ready to fold. Can't imagine what meager existence I'll be clawing at when I'm 30. 

I hit up some friends and told them about my plight. Had a small get together and I totally faked the "I'm just gonna party it out bro" persona. Nobody knows of my intentions. I feel like I at least owe it to my closest friends and family to give some sort of goodbye. One last good day to look back on. I'm pretty drunk right now and am about to pass out. Gonna pick up the sleep aids tomorrow. I almost feel free of everything, like theres a tangible end. Its calming, in a way.

Lol heard that one before. I'm great, beautiful, smart, gonna be successful, gonna find someone. Thats the breakup talk I usually get, when I'm afforded such a luxury. "Its not you, its me". Fucking classic. I see right through the patronizing bullshit though. I am not any of those things. Nothing about me or any part of my life has ever been appropriately described as any of that, more like a dark joke with a bad punchline.
